name: wb
description: Token-efficient WB CLI operations and safe multi-repository workflows

interface.shortDescription: Operate repository fleets with fewer agent tokens.
interface.longDescription: Use the WB CLI for isolated worktrees, fleet hooks, dependency waves, CI audits, migrations, reusable recipes, repository verification, and audited merger cleanup.
defaultPrompt: Create a safe WB worktree for this change.
Propagate these releases with minimal CI builds.

Drain compatible completed branches with the WB merger workflow, prove exact remote CI receipt, reconcile the canonical checkout after every PR merge into main—including only the verified registered nested-worktree exception—before release/tag, installation, cleanup, or the next merge-cycle action. Never use a distribution channel the owning product marks blocked or unverified for installation evidence; use an exact source-built artifact only where explicitly permitted, otherwise report release evidence blocked and keep the task queued before cleaning worktrees.
